description: This file defines the sendEmail class which handles creating and sending email drafts with optional PDF attachments within the SuiteCRM application. It primarily manages email object creation, populates email fields, attaches PDF notes, and redirects to a compose view.

classes.name: sendEmail
classes.description: A class responsible for creating email drafts, attaching PDFs, and initiating email composition within SuiteCRM. It is noted to violate the single responsibility principle and should ideally be refactored into dedicated modules.

methods.name: send_email
methods.description: Creates a new email draft, sets relevant properties, optionally attaches a PDF note, and redirects to a compose view. It uses global variables, retrieves contact info, sets email fields, saves draft and note objects, and handles attachment file operations.
